name: classify_signal
description: Classifies every inbound signal and routes it to the correct domain agent. Deterministic dict — no model.

name: assemble_brief
description: Assembles the closeout brief from all agent outputs and writes it to Firestore.

name: log_escalation
description: Records a compound escalation event to the audit log.

name: log_deadline_event
description: Appends a deadline lifecycle event (created, escalated, confirmed, superseded) to the audit log.

name: verify_deadline
description: Marks a deadline as verified and records the verifying attorney.

name: confirm_deadline
description: Confirms attorney ownership of a deadline. Clears UNCONFIRMED status.

name: supersede_deadline
description: Supersedes an old deadline with a corrected one, preserving history.

name: advance_entry_status
description: Advances a time entry through the billing state machine. Enforces VALID_TRANSITIONS.

name: write_time_entry
description: Creates a new time entry in Firestore with full audit trail.

name: write_down_entry
description: Reduces hours/amount on a time entry with a required reason.

name: write_off_entry
description: Writes off a time entry to zero with a required reason.

name: update_entry_narrative
description: Adds or updates the narrative on a pending time entry.

name: compute_budget_utilization
description: Computes budget utilization pct from billed + approved-unbilled. Fires WARN/CRITICAL alerts at thresholds.

name: check_invoice_readiness
description: Checks whether a matter's approved entries are ready to invoice.

name: generate_invoice
description: Generates a LEDES 1998B invoice from approved time entries.

name: create_client_comm
description: Creates a client communication draft (outbound) held for attorney approval.

name: approve_client_comm_draft
description: Marks a draft as attorney-approved. Does not send — queuing is separate.

name: queue_client_comm_for_delivery
description: Queues an approved draft for delivery. Still held — actual send requires external action.

name: log_client_comm_sent
description: Records that a communication was delivered (sent externally).

name: create_inbound_message
description: Creates an inbound message record from a triaged client email.

name: snooze_inbound
description: Snoozes an inbound message for later review.

name: dismiss_inbound
description: Dismisses an inbound message with a recorded reason.

name: log_anomaly
description: Records a detected anomaly with severity, confidence, and detector name.
